biothings.name: uterine corpus bizarre leiomyoma
biothings.definition: A morphologic variant of uterine corpus leiomyoma characterized by significant cytologic atypia. The atypical cells are large with pleomophic hyperchromatic nuclei. [NCIT:C40167]
biothings.synonyms: bizarre leiomyoma of body of uterus, body of uterus bizarre leiomyoma, uterine corpus bizarre leiomyoma, uterine corpus leiomyoma with bizarre nuclei, uterine corpus leiomyoma, atypical variant, uterine corpus Symplastic leiomyoma

biothings.name: uterine corpus apoplectic leiomyoma
biothings.definition: A morphologic variant of uterine corpus leiomyoma characterized by zones of hemorrhagic infarction surrounded by hypercellular areas. It usually develops in women of childbearing years, particularly those that are pregnant, post-partum, or taking oral contraceptives. [NCIT:C40165]
biothings.synonyms: uterine corpus hemorrhagic cellular leiomyoma, uterine corpus leiomyoma with apoplectic change

biothings.name: uterine corpus cellular leiomyoma
biothings.definition: A morphologic variant of leiomyoma arising from the uterine corpus. It is characterized by a dense cellular infiltrate composed of spindle or round cells with scant cytoplasm and a less obvious interlacing fascicle pattern. [NCIT:C40163]
biothings.synonyms: body of uterus cellular leiomyoma, cellular leiomyoma of body of uterus, uterine corpus cellular leiomyoma

biothings.name: uterine corpus epithelioid leiomyoma
biothings.definition: A morphologic variant of uterine corpus leiomyoma characterized by the presence of round or polygonal epithelioid smooth muscle cells forming clusters. [NCIT:C40164]

biothings.name: uterine corpus myxoid leiomyoma
biothings.definition: A morphologic variant of uterine corpus leiomyoma characterized by extensive myxoid degeneration of the neoplasm connective tissue stroma. [NCIT:C40166]

opentargets.name: uterine corpus leiomyoma
opentargets.description: A benign smooth muscle neoplasm arising from the body of the uterus. It is characterized by the presence of spindle cells with cigar-shaped nuclei, interlacing fascicles, and a whorled pattern.

opentargets.name: uterine corpus epithelioid leiomyoma
opentargets.description: A morphologic variant of uterine corpus leiomyoma characterized by the presence of round or polygonal epithelioid smooth muscle cells forming clusters.

opentargets.name: hereditary leiomyomatosis and renal cell cancer
opentargets.description: Hereditary leiomyomatosis and renal cell cancer (HLRCC) is a hereditary cancer syndrome characterized by a predisposition to cutaneous and uterine leiomyomas and, in some families, to renal cell cancer.

opentargets.name: uterine benign neoplasm
opentargets.description: A non-metastasizing neoplasm that arises from the uterine corpus or the cervix. Representative examples include leiomyoma, adenomyoma, and endocervical polyp.

opentargets.name: benign metastasizing leiomyoma
opentargets.description: A rare disorder that affects women with a history of uterine leiomyoma, which is found to metastasise within extrauterine sites.The disease develops as a proliferation of multiple nodules composed of smooth muscle cells.The most frequent site of metastasis is the lungs, although other areas may also be affected as well, including some atypical locations, e.g. the heart or spinal cord.
